title: Nice tour
text: It is worth it, it is enjoyable and you visit places of interest in the city, although it does not include visits to the interior of the monuments, you cannot ask for more for that price either
author: Miguel_M

title: Great experience and I recommend it.
text:
It has been a very enriching experience.
The guide is charming and has many tables.
To be repeated without a doubt.
author: JoseRamon_R

title: Historical interest
text:
The PILAR guide, very good and concerned that we understand everything.
The neighborhood is worth visiting, with its churches, palaces and market.
author: milasR768LV

title: They don't tell us everything
text:
The tour proposal was misleading.
We were sold a tour of: the cathedral, the Giralda, and the Jewish quarter.
We only visited the Jewish quarter.

It is fortunate that the guide Luis was very interesting.
We had to buy other tickets to visit the cathedral, which is unacceptable.
author: Carole_N
